authorization: 用户要求补齐Python/标准库/系统依赖驻留、定位文件访问，然后另开自然JCT
inputs: byte-identical verified private tmpfs copies; retain pre/post hashes on every call; mlock inputs before preflight
outputs: own tmpfs; artifacts fsync before return; archive after all measurement; power-loss persistence not claimed
artifact_ids: session-local UUID5 of opaque fixed namespace, session key and compute ordinal; identical across policies; strict session registry validation
quality: same stage3b SYSTEM, strict final schema/artifact/reference/consumption; no posthoc normalization
failure_rule: Stop entire new experiment at first answer/protocol/native/source/ownership violation, worker-lifetime disk input or major fault, residency gap, or generation limit. Retain every batch and failure; no replacements.
host_scope: affinity is not exclusive reservation; never stop others or alter global THP/NUMA/page cache settings
scope: three known development parents; targeted replication of prior 3-session anomaly; not independent holdout or full matrix
sentinels: one real three-tool group after model load and before each cycle; diagnostic only, all raw values retained; no hidden stability-based selection
tool_runtime: private SHA256-verified Python 3.13 interpreter plus complete stdlib (excluding bytecode caches), frozen site-packages and current LeasePath sources; PYTHONHOME and PYTHONPATH fixed; byte-identical numerical dependencies; original system ELF/config files pinned by hash and device/inode
recipe_change: One numerical thread in every NumPy/SciPy/OpenMP pool; four logical CPUs cover two physical cores including their SMT siblings per tool. Different workload configuration from previous two-thread runs; do not pool their timings.
cpu_selection: Fixed from read-only 10-second per-CPU load/topology sample before new tool measurements; affinity is not reservation; other jobs remain unconstrained.
diagnostic: two warmups then three paired logistic two/one-thread comparisons in fixed AB/BA/AB order; choice of one thread is to remove BLAS helpers, not fastest mean selection
prior_preflights: both failed and retained; never relabelled or used as passed admission
design: New natural-only counterbalanced shared-host observation, six permutations, no padding. Earlier failed attempts remain separate. CPU and memory bandwidth not exclusive.

phases.name: natural
phases.interpretation: actual unpadded tools; shared host observed, all six policy order permutations; repeats are not independent parents

local_resource_rule: GPU exclusive to engine PID; read_bytes=0 since worker exec; wait4 full-lifetime major_faults=0 and block_input_ops=0; old phase-level IO retained; no ptrace during JCT; loaded non-tmpfs file maps must be in pinned manifest
host_resource_rule: read-only covariates retained. Previous global-PSI stability gate not claimed passed; no host-exclusive natural causal claim. No sample rejection or reruns based on measured JCT.
model_residency: PROT_READ MAP_SHARED mlock for full verified model, all runtime, input and dependency files; mincore before each batch; fail on missing page or identity change; do not change RLIMIT_MEMLOCK
file_attribution: Preparation strace covers real file opens/reads/mmaps; worker import windows retain counters and exact origins. No privileged kernel fault-address tracing; historical file cannot be retroactively reconstructed.
instrumentation_scope: Same version for every policy. Audit/open/import metadata included in natural JCT; ptrace, copying, hashing full model, tests and archives excluded from measurement.
model_page_keeper: A dedicated own non-GPU process pins only the model; parent pins all other files. Each respects its inherited RLIMIT_MEMLOCK. No limit elevation or duplicate COW pages.
version_change: Add kernel execve executable and shebang interpreter residency; per-descendant resource attribution. Previous attempt stopped after 13 native probes and 3 correct sentinels; zero live tasks. New independent ledger, same natural JCT design and strict gates.
